title: calcearia erythrocarpa
intro: Calcearia erythrocarpa, commonly known as Chinese Thunder of Heaven or Chinese Thunder of Heaven calceolaria, is a flowering plant native to China and Southeast Asia. It is known for its vibrant red flowers, which have been used in traditional medicine for their medicinal properties. The health benefits of Calcearia erythrocarpa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections, wounds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of promoting wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections.
